There is an area called "Raptor Grounds" near Northwatch Hold. Coords: 57, 53
Many many raptors in close proximity. Great if you have a whole group.

This took me a while because I had a very poor drop rate, even when I logged out, then back in.  I think I had to kill 10 raptors for each horn that I harvested.

To find the raptors, follow the Gold Road south out of Crossroads.  The raptors will be on the East side of the road.  They are mostly found at a distance of about 1/2 to 2/3 of the way south, towards the road junction where you can turn west to Camp Taurajo.

Eventually, you will come to a 'Wash' which has a bridge on it, where the gold road crosses it.  I think this is the first bridge south of Crossroads, but by the time you reach the bridge, you will already have been passing raptors on the east side of the road, for a little while.  There are also raptors around the bridge.

Just a bit before you reach the bridge, there is a 'wash' or chasm that heads east towards Northwatch Hold.  If you follow this path east, you will eventually come to a place called 'Raptor Grounds,' located about half way towards Northwatch Hold.  You should also be able to find a lot of the Sunscale Scytheclaw Raptors there.
